erasure.title: Delete Dzvin account
erasure.description: Deletion is irreversible. Export any records you need first. This applies to Dzvin data; certain records may be retained to meet applicable legal obligations.

erasure.notAvailable: Account deletion is not yet available while safe cleanup and data retention requirements are being finalized.
erasure.statusUnavailable: Account deletion status is temporarily unavailable.
erasure.understand: I understand that my personal Dzvin records may be deleted permanently.
erasure.freshAuthRequired: A fresh Zitadel sign-in is required. Use the reauthenticate button and confirm again.
erasure.requestUnavailable: Your request could not be accepted. Do not assume data was removed; retry later or contact support.
erasure.requested: Request received. Your Dzvin access is blocked and remaining cleanup is in progress. Your global Zitadel identity is preserved.
